card.name: Latin inscriptions and wish-style 'may'
card.fires_on: Pieces of capitalised Latin inscription text (Roman legion altars, emperor names) and the word 'may' opening a blessing or wish clause in religious or poetic text.

modes.label: Roman inscriptions
modes.description: Letters or partial words inside transcribed Latin dedications naming emperors and legions.
modes.example: IMP CAES<< I>> AELIO ANTONINO AVG PIO

modes.label: Blessing 'may'
modes.description: The word may starting a wish or blessing clause.
modes.example: May Yahweh bless you and keep you; may Yahweh cause his face to shine upon you and be gracious to you;<< may>> Yahweh lift up his countenance
